repository_policy.policy_description: Project/source-pack policy for this pharmacology ingestion keeps these raw course-derived extraction files local-only. Raw TCM curriculum Markdown files in curriculum/pharm/v7_extracted/ are extracted working materials from AcuTing_Pharm_Master_Extraction_v7.zip.
repository_policy.reproducibility_note: A clean git clone alone will not contain the raw v7 extracted Markdown files. Independent source coverage verification requires unzipping curriculum/pharm/AcuTing_Pharm_Master_Extraction_v7.zip into curriculum/pharm/v7_extracted/ locally.
